svg.aria-label: Sketchbook page 1, drawn in crayon. Echo. Hinglish creator comments flow into ranked buying-intent clusters: wants the link, asks the price, just vibing. A critic agent rejects a hallucinated luxury yacht suggestion; buyers who asked get a Pay with UPI button.
